text:
Rina C: Postmortem follow-up from last night's vendor cascade (cloud IAM throttling + model-reg 5xx). Created tracker: https://tracker.redwood/actions/INC-915. Owners please claim.

Omar T: I'll pick up registry snapshot + cache work. Plan: in-memory LRU for metadata (TTL 30s) + gzipped read-only snapshot for configs. ETA: 2026-02-09.

Becky L: I'll take auth client hardening and alerting. Will propose retry budgets and add auth_retry_ratio chart. ETA: 2026-02-06.

reliability-bot: Actions created: R-A915-1, R-A915-2, R-A915-3. Reminder: update status within 48h.

Victor M: Ops note: ensure 2-week owner rotation on any action > 3 days. Add vendor ticket ID and contact info in tracker.

Rina C: Observations: spikes line up with midnight key rotations + registry flapping. Short-term mitigations: conservative retries, local caching, and fallback to dedicated model-variants.

Omar T: cache details: max_entries=10k, ttl=30s, exclude signed URLs. Snapshot will be encrypted and rotated by KMS. Adding integration test to simulate registry 5xx -> snapshot fallback.

Becky L: proposed retry config (will open PR):
```
initial_backoff_ms=120
max_retries=3
max_backoff_ms=3500
jitter=true
circuit_breaker: failures=12, window=60s
```
This should throttle the retry amplification.

Rina C: please add vendor escalation IDs in tracker. Also add a new alert: auth_retry_rate > 40/min to page SRE.

Omar T: added PR link and tests. Marked action in_progress. Vendor ticket: CLOUD-AUTH-7682.

Becky L: opening vendor case now, will paste ID. Added dashboard draft link.

Rina C: schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to confirm ETAs. I'll consolidate and post a brief note to leadership after the sync. Thanks.

Victor M: I'll add a recurring monthly "vendor dependency resilience" item to the incident cadence docs.

Becky L: confirmed. PR incoming in ~3h.

Omar T: confirmed ownership and ETA.

Rina C: closing thread for now ":white_check_mark:" will reconvene after the 15m sync.
